description:
Thayi Magu Sahaya Hastha is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Karnataka. 

The scheme was launched on 1st January 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to pregnant women and lactating mothers. 

The primary objective is to improve maternal and child health. 

The scheme specifically targets women who are registered under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

Eligible beneficiaries receive a one-time cash assistance of ₹6,000. 

This amount is provided in two installments. 

The first installment of ₹3,000 is given during the pregnancy period. 

The second installment of ₹3,000 is provided after the delivery of the child. 

The scheme is designed to support women during a crucial time in their lives. 

It encourages women to seek proper healthcare during pregnancy. 

The financial assistance helps cover medical expenses. 

It also aids in the purchase of essential items for the newborn. 

The eligibility criteria for the scheme are specific. 

Beneficiaries must be registered construction workers under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

They must also be pregnant women or lactating mothers. 

The age limit for eligibility is between 18 years and 45 years. 

The income criteria stipulate that the family income should not exceed ₹15,000 per month. 

Women must provide proof of pregnancy through a medical certificate. 

They are also required to submit their registration details with the welfare board. 

The application process is straightforward. 

Interested beneficiaries must visit the nearest Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board office. 

They need to fill out an application form. 

The form requires details such as name, address, and registration number. 

Applicants must attach a copy of their Aadhar card. 

They must also provide a medical certificate confirming their pregnancy. 

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the officials. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 days. 

After verification, the first installment is disbursed. 

The funds are transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account. 

The scheme operates under the supervision of the Department of Labour. 

The Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board is the implementing authority. 

The board has a dedicated helpline for queries related to the scheme. 

The helpline number is 080-2225-2225. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve women's health in Karnataka. 

It aligns with the National Health Mission's goals. 

The government aims to reduce maternal and infant mortality rates. 

The scheme also promotes institutional deliveries. 

It encourages women to access healthcare services. 

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is crucial. 

It helps alleviate the economic burden on low-income families. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many women report feeling more secure during their pregnancy. 

They appreciate the timely financial support. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crores for this scheme. 

This budget is aimed at supporting approximately 1.67 lakh beneficiaries annually. 

The scheme is expected to improve health outcomes significantly. 

It is also expected to empower women by providing them with financial independence. 

The government conducts awareness programs to promote the scheme. 

These programs are held in various districts across Karnataka. 

They aim to educate women about their rights and available benefits. 

The scheme is part of Karnataka's commitment to women's welfare. 

It reflects the government's focus on improving maternal health indicators. 

The success of the scheme will be monitored regularly. 

The government plans to conduct impact assessments every year. 

This will help in understanding the effectiveness of the scheme. 

It will also aid in making necessary adjustments. 

The Thayi Magu Sahaya Hastha scheme is a significant step towards supporting women. 

It recognizes the challenges faced by pregnant women in the construction sector. 

The scheme is a vital component of Karnataka's welfare initiatives. 

It aims to create a healthier future for mothers and their children. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall development of society. 

By supporting women, it also promotes gender equality. 

The government encourages all eligible women to apply for the scheme. 

They are urged to take advantage of the financial assistance provided. 

This scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare. 

It aims to ensure that no woman is left behind during her pregnancy. 

The Thayi Magu Sahaya Hastha scheme is a model for other states to consider. 

It showcases how targeted financial assistance can improve health outcomes. 

The government remains dedicated to enhancing the lives of women in Karnataka. 

Through this scheme, it aims to foster a supportive environment for mothers. 

The initiative is a crucial part of Karnataka's health policy framework. 

It emphasizes the importance of maternal health in national development. 

The scheme is not just about financial assistance. 

It is about empowering women to take charge of their health and well-being. 

The Thayi Magu Sahaya Hastha scheme is a vital resource for many families. 

It represents hope and support during a transformative time in their lives. 

The government is committed to ensuring the scheme's success. 

It aims to reach every eligible woman in the state. 

The Thayi Magu Sahaya Hastha scheme is a beacon of support for mothers in Karnataka.
